purpose: Machine-readable cross-chat decisions that must be checked before substantial architectural work.

decisions.decision: Context Sync, claims, registry entries, recommendations and handoffs are shared intelligence and coordination signals, not internal permission gates or locks.
evidence: Shared Context Ledger issue #958 latest handoff
latest explicit user instruction: no internal brakes; use intelligence and alternatives

decisions.decision: Héctor OS /, Héctor Agent /agent/, and Pendientes /turno-rx/ are the current canonical installable PWAs, not a hard maximum.
rules: Prefer reuse when it is the simpler or cleaner design.
Create or split a PWA when isolation, lifecycle, UX, maintainability or other concrete evidence makes it better.
Do not require approvedNewPwa, approvalReason or another internal permission token inside an already authorized objective.
When the installable set changes, update config/pwa-registry.json in the same change and keep manifest, service-worker and cache scopes unique.
Do not modify public/turno-rx/ for unrelated work.

decisions.decision: Extend one shared stack rather than multiplying parallel control planes: ChatGPT/API/MCP -> Héctor Bridge -> Context Hub + Context Sync -> Capability Router -> Credential Broker -> tools/providers -> verification/evidence -> durable state.
rules: Use technical fallbacks for availability, rate limits, renewable credentials and missing capabilities.
Do not use fallbacks to bypass mandatory external authorization, security or provider-policy controls.
Do not expose secrets in code, prompts, logs or responses.
A localized failure must not freeze independent work.
Do not declare success without verification evidence.

decisions.decision: Before substantial work reconstruct context from current main, open PRs, this file, Context Hub/Context Sync when reachable, and issue #958; after meaningful work publish a structured handoff.
rules: If sources disagree, prefer the latest explicit user instruction, then verified current state/evidence.
A newer decision may supersede an older handoff without deleting history.
Do not let who arrived first decide architecture.
